This iconic establishment has become an integral part of the city's culinary heritage, offering a taste of nostalgia and tradition that resonates deeply with the people of Hanoi.

The Trang Tien shop is not merely a place to purchase ice cream but a destination that offers a unique slice of Hanoi’s cultural tapestry. It stands as a testament to the city’s rich culinary traditions and the enduring legacy of its artisanal crafts.

Visitors to the shop are often drawn by the promise of a sweet treat that captures the essence of Hanoi. The shop’s location near Hoan Kiem Lake adds to its allure, making it a perfect stop for those exploring the historic heart of the city.
